note: BASELINE-OUTSIDE §5 call-contract policy. excluded_paths and exceptions are reviewed; forbidden roles cite their source.
limits: Static text scan of restRpc(...) and .rpc(...) in apps/** only (minus excluded_paths). Names built at run time, calls through other helpers, direct table reads/writes (restGet / restPatch / restInsert) and references inside SQL function bodies are NOT seen.
An exception checks only that the function exists, that the calling role has EXECUTE and that forbidden roles have none — NOT the argument names.
A map-based call (ORDER_FUNCTIONS) is checked for EVERY name in the map, even if a given call site uses a subset.
Any new non-parseable site, or an exception that no longer matches a site, fails until reviewed.
